WITH seg_year AS (
  SELECT
    c.Segment,
    substr(y.Date, 1, 4) AS yr,
    SUM(y.Consumption) AS consumption
  FROM yearmonth y
  JOIN customers c
    ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    AND substr(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
  GROUP BY c.Segment, substr(y.Date, 1, 4)

seg_pivot AS (
  SELECT
    Segment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '2012' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,

  GROUP BY Segment
),
calc AS (
  SELECT
    Segment,
    consumption_2012,
    consumption_2013,
    (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) AS increase,
    ((consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) / consumption_2013) * 100.0 AS pct_increase

)
